children: Malaysian authorities charged former minister Jamil Khir Baharom with allegedly misappropriating 860 million ringgit ($210 million) from the Muslim pilgrimage fund Tabung Haji, according to Bloomberg.
He is the second United Malays National Organisation leader to face charges over the fund in as many weeks.

title: Malaysia Charges Ex-Minister Jamil Khir Baharom in Tabung Haji Probe
